scenario: A custom thread type's designation is removed from the library (or is stored on a feature but no longer listed). Opening that Thread or Hole > Tapped feature and pressing OK makes threadData fall back to the type's first designation (e[1][0]), so the feature is built with another designation's pitch and diameters and the dialog reports no error.
fix: For custom types (c non-null) return null when the designation is not found instead of e[1][0]; threadOf (cmd-thread.js line 113) and tapThread (cmd-hole.js line 175) then use their stored-values fallback or show the validation message. The ISO fallback can stay as it was.
